version_name: WP5 integration: mechanism catalogue v2, Response register, model check
features: WP5 financial-mechanism catalogue rebuilt from the final D5.2: 31 mechanisms with per-field sources (WS-2, PR #100).
Response register: EBM classification, governance, implementing stakeholders, strategy pairing and 11-tenet appraisal (WS-3a, PR #100).
Model check on load: instrument-like Drivers/Activities/Ecosystem Services and Responses without feedback (WS-3b, PR #100).
WP5 shared vocabulary and D5.3 intervention-to-operation data (WS-0/WS-1, PR #100).

high: Response type/target/status are stored as language-independent codes; projects saved in another language are converted on load (WS-3a).
Scenario Builder stores scenarios at data$analysis$scenarios; legacy locations migrate on every load path (WS-0).
